skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Builds unique, production-ready frontend components, pages, and app interfaces. It emphasizes deliberate aesthetic direction, polished visual details, and working implementation.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents to create distinctive frontend interfaces with strong design direction and working code.
skill.author: DennisLiuCk

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md is plain UTF-8 Traditional Chinese guidance, and the high entropy heuristic appears caused by non-ASCII prose rather than binary, encrypted, or hidden content.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (7.88 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable UTF-8 text with Traditional Chinese frontend design instructions. No binary payload, encryption, encoded command, or hidden prompt injection content was found.

content.value_statement: Many AI-generated interfaces feel generic and lack a clear visual point of view. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished frontend work with deliberate aesthetics.
actual_capabilities: Guides the agent to choose a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Supports components, pages, app interfaces, and other frontend surfaces.
Encourages production-ready HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar code.
Promotes stronger typography, color, animation, layout, and visual detail choices.
Discourages generic AI design patterns such as predictable layouts and overused gradients.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a complete frontend framework.
It does not include source code assets, templates, or reusable components.
Generated results still depend on the host model and project context.
It may need separate accessibility, performance, and browser testing.

use_cases.title: Create a product page
use_cases.description: Design and implement a memorable product page with a clear visual concept and working frontend code.

use_cases.title: Refresh an app screen
use_cases.description: Turn a plain dashboard or workflow screen into a polished interface with stronger layout and interaction details.

use_cases.title: Prototype a creative website
use_cases.description: Explore bold typography, color, motion, and composition for an experimental website or portfolio concept.

prompt_templates.title: Build a simple page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a landing page for a small design studio. Include the visual direction, layout, colors, and working frontend implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with current UI problems
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to redesign this dashboard screen. Keep the same features, but make the layout clearer, more distinctive, and production ready.

prompt_templates.title: Match a specific audience
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with brand and user context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a mobile-first event page for architects. Choose a precise aesthetic direction and explain how each design choice serves that audience.

prompt_templates.title: Create a full interaction concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a richer app experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to design and implement a multi-step onboarding flow. Include motion, responsive behavior, visual states, and refined micro-interactions.

output_examples.input: Create a homepage for a boutique coffee subscription service.
output_examples.output: A refined homepage concept with expressive typography, warm product photography placement, clear subscription steps, and responsive frontend implementation notes.

output_examples.input: Redesign a metrics dashboard that looks too generic.
output_examples.output: A more distinctive dashboard direction with stronger information hierarchy, restrained color accents, custom card treatments, and interaction details for key metrics.

output_examples.input: Build a portfolio page for a motion designer.
output_examples.output: A visually memorable portfolio concept with bold composition, animation moments, project-focused sections, and guidance for polished implementation.

best_practices: Give the agent the product goal, target audience, and technical stack before asking for code.
Ask for one clear aesthetic direction and require the implementation to match it consistently.
Review generated work for accessibility, responsiveness, and maintainability before production use.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a vague beautiful page without context, audience, or constraints.
Do not accept decorative effects that make content harder to read or use.
Do not treat the generated interface as production ready without testing real states and data.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend components, pages, and app interfaces with stronger visual direction and working implementation.

faq.question: Can it work with React or Vue?
faq.answer: Yes. The source guidance mentions HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend approaches.

faq.question: Does it provide finished production code?
faq.answer: It guides the agent toward production-quality code, but teams should still test accessibility, responsiveness, and edge cases.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide components, pages, application screens, and broader interface concepts.

faq.question: How should I get the best results?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, goal, brand constraints, technical stack, and any existing UI problems.

faq.question: Does the skill include external scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill contains only a SKILL.md instruction file and no detected scripts or network behavior.
